claim_legs.durability: The original failed auditor, its prospective pins and exact failed output remain tracked beside the separately qualified correction. Exact copy plans and saved-only join/recovery retain all final evidence without fixture replay or raw-log access; the book source is watched.
claim_legs.falsify: The original selector adapter rejects valid records; the corrected source/event reconstruction agrees with the independent selector and rejects altered archived records. Joined coverage, source, root and reversal controls reject, as do independent book count and redistribution controls.
claim_legs.rederive: Exact selected single/composition domains, historical source rosters and unchanged row/state/native-close oracles agree with independent physical-record counts. The composition partitions reconstruct the previously qualified join.

commit_gate: Staged doctrine checks and normal commit hooks must pass before this atomic slice is committed.
earlier_falsifiers: Original source and saved verdicts authenticated; unchanged row/state/header oracles rerun. Earlier main routines and their complete embedded falsifier loops are not replayed.
scope: Join every selected single-close report and bounded primary/grouped composition from original retained rows. Authenticate exact source epochs, complete coverage, actual versus reported closure, first-error precedence, profile state, effects and recovery. No fixture, old main, original producer, native process or new root. Genuine omissions, final release applicability, native/lifetime and historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain separately gated; this does not qualify all Cartesian compositions or ambiguous operating-system close failures.
